method.eligibility: >=6 events in each training era; positive 20d excess return and excess up-rate in each era
method.selection: maximize the minimum 20d excess return across the two training eras; 2020+ is not used for selection

score.definition_warning: Recent-low + score-recovery event is a new diagnostic construction, not an existing production rule.

concentration.method: Strict past-only Concentration V1 analog validation; abs(streak)>=2 targets, 5-session target decluster, same direction, streak tolerance 1, same MA200 regime, top40 analogs, 5-session candidate decluster.
concentration.engine: vectorized equivalent of Concentration V1 distance/settings

warnings: Sentiment and composite score histories are reconstructed, not fully publication-time archives.
Box coverage is intermittent because only point-in-time eligible boxes are used.
Common event studies are historical diagnostics; they are not prospective confirmation.
Concentration walk-forward is stricter than the current-date analog view but still uses a feature set designed on historical data.
